calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.category,
  AVG(fsw.closing_value) as avg_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fsw.week_ending_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key
WHERE s.region = 'West'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 44 AND 47
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.category,
  AVG(fsw.closing_value) as avg_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fsw.week_ending_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key
WHERE s.region = 'West'
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 44 AND 47
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category
